en: \rIris: Later!
\rBianca: My knowledge of Pokémon will help us get along better!
\bHugh: Just to let you know... They're about to feel my rage!
\bHugh: Back me up.
\bHugh: Sure.
\rHilda: Trust me, I'm really good at this stuff!
\rHilda: Yup, good choice!
\rHilda: See ya!
\bHilbert: When we team up, no one can stop us!
\bHilbert: Ready when you are!
\bHilbert: See you again!
\rRosa: We'll keep things exciting for you!
\rRosa: You can count on me! I always do my best.
\rRosa: Laters!
\bNate: We can't let this awesome opportunity pass us by!
\bNate: Now let's show them how it's done!
\bNate: Okay!
\rJuniper: Will your path be promising?
\rJuniper: Show them what you have learned!
\rJuniper: Bye!
\bN: I will show you that my love for my friends permeates every cell of my body.
\bN: Show me just what kinds of wonderful dreams you have.
\bN: Ok!
\bGhetsis: Liberate every Pokémon from every person in the world, and release them all.
\bGhetsis: My beautiful ideals must be realized.
\bGhetsis: Farewell.
\rViola: I promise I'll snag some amazing photos in the process!
\rViola: Well, I'll see you later!
\bGrant: Let's climb this wall together.
\bGrant: It's important that you never give up.
\bGrant: Until we meet again!
\rKorrina: Time for Lady Korrina's grand appearance!
\rKorrina: It's time to get things rolling!
\rKorrina: See you!
\bRamos: I'll show dem wizened trees can still blossom! Not that I'm old, mind yeh.
\bRamos: I may be old, but I'm worth at least five younger Trainers!
\bRamos: I'll see ya 'round!
\bClemont: The future is now, thanks to science.
\bClemont: Me? Okay, I'll do my best!
\bClemont: Bye for now!
\rValerie: My Pokémon may appear frail and delicate, but looks can be deceiving.
\rValerie: Shall I join you?
\rValerie: See you later.
\rOlympia: So the stars decree. Olympia shall fight by your side.
\rOlympia: A shared destiny! Let us embark together to face it as one!
\rOlympia: Farewell.
\bWulfric: Know who I am?
\bWulfric: Y'know, I'm as tough as an iceberg.
\bWulfric: You take care o' yourself now!
\rMalva: I'll handle this.
\rMalva: I do so hate to be kept waiting.
\rMalva: Hmph.
\bSiebold: I'm very much looking forward to a night full of exceptional treats and battles.
\bSiebold: I can count on you to bring the flavor!
\bSiebold: Excuse me.
\bWikstrom: And let my body be thy shield!
\bWikstrom: My word.
\rDrasna: Oh, goodness! Is it my turn already?
\rDrasna: They'll be satisfied tonight with our performance.
\rDrasna: Oh, dear me!
\rDiantha: Allow me to show you how I shine, living up to the title of Champion!
\rDiantha: It's your time to shine too.
\rDiantha: See you around!
\rShauna: Let's make some great memories!
\rShauna: I never, ever wanna forget this!
\rShauna: Buh-bye!
\bTierno: Shall we dance on beatdown?
\bTierno: Challenge accepted!
\bTierno: See ya next time!
\bTrevor: E-excuse me! I believe I could be of help!
\bTrevor: Thank you so much!
\bTrevor: Alright.
\rSerena: Don't cut corners! You have to give it your all.
\rSerena: Our feelings are one and the same!
\rSerena: See you!
\bCalem: Teaming up with you seems to be the quickest path to getting stronger.
\bCalem: I'm just getting started!
\bCalem: See ya!
\bSycamore: How is your Pokémon journey going so far?
\bSycamore: What sorts of encounters await us today?
